This FloPlast MiniFlo 76mm half-round external gutter stop end in black provides an effective seal for the end of a guttering run. It is specifically designed for MiniFlo guttering systems, making it ideal for managing rainwater runoff on various garden buildings such as garages, sheds, and summer houses. Constructed from durable uPVC, this gutter stop end offers low maintenance and longevity. It features pre-lubricated gutter seals for a secure connection and a pre-fitted retaining clip for easy installation, ensuring reliable drainage for various projects.
